title: enriched-category
description: A category-like structure over a monoidal base V whose hom-objects are objects of V rather than sets, with composition Hom(B,C) ⊗ Hom(A,B) → Hom(A,C) via the tensor and identities I → Hom(A,A) via the unit. Generalizes an ordinary category (which is enriched over Set); lets morphisms carry topological, algebraic, or homotopical structure.

base.description: the monoidal category V the hom-objects live in

hom-object.description: for each pair (A,B), an object Hom(A,B) of V

composition-via-tensor.description: Hom(B,C) ⊗ Hom(A,B) → Hom(A,C), associative as a diagram in V

identity-via-unit.description: I → Hom(A,A) supplying identities, satisfying the unit laws in V
